name: systeme.io
line: Creator marketing suite with newsletters, automations and system email.

free.text: Free: 2,000 contacts, unlimited email; sales capped at USD 10,000 lifetime

cells.newsletters: Yes, newsletters; verified sender domain and site needed
cells.api: Yes, newsletter/campaign API; no arbitrary app-email relay

subs.math: 1,000 subscribers × 4 = 4,000 emails, within the 2,000-contact Free plan. An owned domain, sending checks and tax are outside the base price.
5,000 subscribers × 4 = 20,000 emails. The Startup plan holds 5,000 contacts. An owned domain, sending checks and tax are outside the base price.
10,000 subscribers × 4 = 40,000 emails. The Webinar plan holds 10,000 contacts. An owned domain, sending checks and tax are outside the base price.
50,000 subscribers × 4 = 200,000 emails. The Unlimited plan holds this audience. An owned domain, sending checks and tax are outside the base price.

appmail.math: 5,000 stored contacts and 3,000 automation executions. The Startup base is USD 17 a month, but the total for an equivalent sending service is unknown.
5,000 stored contacts and 10,000 automation executions. The Startup base is USD 17 a month, but the total for an equivalent sending service is unknown.
5,000 stored contacts and 50,000 automation executions. The Startup base is USD 17 a month, but the total for an equivalent sending service is unknown.
5,000 stored contacts and 100,000 automation executions. The Startup base is USD 17 a month, but the total for an equivalent sending service is unknown.
